# Bos indicus Carcasses Suspended by the Pelvic Bone Require a Shorter Aging Time to Meet Consumer Expectations Regarding Meat Quality

**Авторы:** Baldassini Welder, Coutinho Marcelo, Rovadoscki Gregori, Menezes Bruna, Tagiariolli Murilo, Torrecilhas Juliana, Leonel Júlia, Pereira Guilherme, Curi Rogério, Machado Neto Otávio, Chardulo Luis Artur

**Журнал:** Foods (2023)

**DOI:** 10.3390/foods12050930


## Abstract

This study evaluated the effects of hanging the carcass by the Achilles tendon (AS) versus pelvic suspension (PS) on meat quality traits.
source_units.reason: article_metadata_header

source_units.text: Bos indicus carcasses of two distinct biological types/sex categories comprised 10 young Brangus heifers and 10 Nellore bulls which were finished in a feedlot.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Half-carcasses of each biological type/sex category were randomly hung using Achilles suspension (n = 20, AS) or pelvic suspension (n = 20, PS) for 48 h.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: At boning, longissimus samples were collected for evaluation by untrained consumers for tenderness, liking of flavor, juiciness and overall acceptability, after aging for 5 or 15 days.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Objective samples were also tested for shear force (SF), Minolta meat colour, ultimate pH, cooking loss (CL) and purge loss (PL).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: There was a positive effect (p < 0.01) of PS on the sensory tenderness of Nellore bulls and Brangus heifers aged for 5 days compared to the AS method.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: At 15 days of aging, difference in sensory tenderness was observed (p < 0.05) in either group.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Additionally, an interaction occurred between the suspension method and the aging of Nellore beef (p < 0.05) on liking of flavor, juiciness and overall acceptance, while the same effects were not observed for Brangus beef (p > 0.05).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Nellore carcasses submitted to PS tended (p = 0.06) to produce more tender meat than those submitted to AS (SF = 44.62 ± 6.96 vs. 50.41 ± 8.04 N), and lower CL (p < 0.05) were found (27.7 vs. 30.9%).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Carcass-suspension methods did not influence meat color, pH or PL in either group (p > 0.05).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The PS contributes to improve the quality of Bos indicus bulls loins; in addition, this method allows a reduction in the aging time from 15 to 5 days, and it can be used to supply meat consumer markets which accept a certain level of eating quality.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text:
Introduction

The beef cattle herd in Brazil is composed mainly of Zebu animals (Bos indicus), with a predominance (roughly 80%) of the Nellore genotype.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Despite their adaptation to tropical climate, Nellore breed take longer to reach targeted sales weight compared to taurine cattle (Bos taurus), such as Aberdeen Angus and Hereford.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Many farms in the southeast and midwest regions rear Nellore animals on pasture, followed by finishing in the feedlot, a system in which the use of bulls is common [1].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This biological model of production supplies a large part of the domestic and export market [2].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It is well known that the meat quality of Bos indicus bulls is limited, especially in terms of tenderness [3,4], when compared to Bos taurus and crossbred animals, with the need for a longer aging time to improve this trait.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: However, considering the costs of a meat-packing plant, very long aging times can render the product excessively expensive.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The use of crossbred cattle (Bos taurus × Bos indicus) finished in the feedlot and slaughtered at a young age has been adopted as a strategy to improve productive performance and meat quality [5], especially tenderness, within a shorter post-mortem aging period.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Additionally, crossbred castrated male and female cattle [6] are increasingly used since there are consumers who are willing to pay more for higher-quality meat products [7].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: It is known that the gender of cattle affects animal performances and growth, and heifer have superior carcass fatness and meat quality traits compared to bulls, as reported by [8,9].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: To supply their own butcher shops, some Brazilian meat-packing companies pay better for carcasses derived from this biological type (low Bos indicus content, heifers or steers carcasses feedlot-finished and slaughtered at a young age).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In the meat-packing industry, the commonly used hanging method of bovine carcasses is suspension by the Achilles tendon (AS).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: This method results in the shortening of selected hindquarter muscles during rigor mortis, which can affect meat quality.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: On the other hand, suspension of the carcass by the pelvic bone, a method known as tenderstretch or PS, is widely used by the Australian and European meat-packing industry in order to improve sensory meat quality, particularly tenderness, as well as reduce the variability of this trait in some muscles [10].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: As described by Ferguson [11], the PS method does not affect the semitendinosus, as this muscle is already stretched and therefore shows no improvement in eating quality.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: During the post-mortem chilling period of carcasses, the tenderness of almost all hindquarter muscles can be improved by the PS method.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Studies suggest that this method may be more effective for tougher meats [12] and may be an alternative to improve the meat quality of bulls [13].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In the Meat Standard Australia (MSA) beef-grading program [14], there is no interaction between Bos indicus and carcass-suspension method on the prediction of eating quality.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Carcass suspension by the pelvic bone is a technique that is inexpensive to implement, producing gains in meat quality [15,16] and adding value to meat products.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: In Brazil, studies evaluating the effects of PS on meat quality are scarce.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Furthermore, there are no studies of the effects of PS on the meat of Bos indicus and crossbred cattle, evaluating sensory and objective traits in different sex classes and under different aging conditions.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Within this context, meat from carcasses suspended by the pelvic bone may require a shorter aging time to meet consumer expectations regarding quality traits, especially beef of carcasses of males with a high Bos indicus content.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Only a few studies with Nellore bulls and Bos indicus carcasses described the interaction of the carcass-suspension method and meat aging, which allows the investigation of its effects on meat quality traits (sensory and objective variables).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Therefore, the aim of this study was to evaluate whether PS can improve quality traits of aged meat from crossbred heifers and Nellore bulls, two contrasting biological types that supply different meat consumer markets in Brazil and abroad.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

Animals and Carcasses

Brangus heifers (n = 10) and Nellore bulls (n = 10), finished in commercial feedlots (Boituva, São Paulo, Brazil), were evaluated.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The animals belonged to the same management group and were submitted to the same nutritional conditions and feedlot period.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The two groups received the same diet, containing 15% forage (sugarcane bagasse) and 85% corn-based concentrate (soybean meal, ground corn, urea, mineral mixture).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The animals were allocated in collective pens, equipped with a bunk and an automatic drinking trough.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The diet was offered ad libitum, twice a day at 8 a.m. and 4 p.m.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The experimental groups were slaughtered at different times (Brangus heifers = 100 days on feed; Nellore bulls = 120 days on feed).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The slaughter weight of the animals of each group was established by the commercial protocol of the slaughterhouse (Boituva, São Paulo, Brazil) based on the standardization of their meat products.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: At the end of feeding period, the final body weight (FBW) was record for Brangus heifers (FBW = 510 ± 41 kg) and Nellore bulls (FBW = 590 ± 57 kg).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The aim of using two such distinct groups was to evaluate the main biological types destined for the two most important models of Brazilian meat production.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Thus, Nellore animals were classified as products of the commodity model—domestic and export market—and crossbred Brangus animals as the premium quality model.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: During processing of the two slaughters, the number of permanent incisors teeth were verified and carcasses were cut longitudinally into two parts and weighed individually.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Carcasses were not electrically stimulated in the current study.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The half-carcasses were randomly suspended by the traditional method (AS; n = 20: 10 Brangus and 10 Nellore) or by the tenderstretch method (PS; n = 20: 10 Brangus and 10 Nellore).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After identification, the carcasses were kept in the cold room (1 °C) for 48 h.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Next, the carcasses were evaluated in the chiller, and the following data were collected: carcass weight; ossification score (physiological maturity); hump height (Bos indicus percentage); fatness score; conformation score; marbling score; backfat thickness; ribeye area; and ultimate pH (48 h) [17].
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Briefly, ossification was assessed by one trained technician, which scored the degree of ossification of the vertebral spinous processes as well as the shape and colour of the rib bones, with the lowest score being 100 and the highest being 590.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: The hump height was recorded in gradients of 5 mm, measuring all of the meat across the hump from the line formed by the dorsal ends of the spinous processes and extended cranially along the dorsal edge of the Ligamentum nuchae, across to the dorsal surface of the Rhomboideus muscle.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Additionally, fatness score was assessed, using 1 to 5 degrees for the distribution of fat cover in the hot carcass (1 = absent; 2 = scarce; 3 = medium; 4 = uniform; 5 = excessive).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Subsequently, conformation score was assessed by development of muscle mass in the hindquarters region (1 = concave; 2 = sub-straight; 3 = straight; 4 = sub-convex; 5 = convex).
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Finally, marbling score was assessed using MSA standard photograph, divided into tenths for grading, creating a score range from 100 to 1100 in increments of 10.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: Backfat thickness (BFT, mm) and ribeye area (REA, cm2) were measured at the 12th/13th rib interface.
source_units.reason: deterministic dependency projection; expert review required

source_units.text: After deboning, Longissimus thoracis et lumborum (LTL) samples (~12 cm) were collected from each half-carcass (AS and PS; two samples each) between the 11th and 13th rib (cranial direction) for subsequent sensory and laboratory analyses of meat quality.
